price_issues.message: source_type 'distributor': prefer a manufacturer datasheet, MMPDS/CMH-17 handbook, standard or peer-reviewed source
source_type 'distributor': prefer a manufacturer datasheet, MMPDS/CMH-17 handbook, standard or peer-reviewed source

mass_change.note: mass change of the selected materials (Ashby scaling) is NOT fed back into the sizing loop — use the Pareto sweep / re-size with the chosen material

notes: DAPCA IV database is military/transport aircraft; for light GA prefer Eastlake (Gudmundsson 2014) and treat DAPCA as an upper reference
structure parts: bottom-up process model; final assembly/systems installation NOT included (give final_assembly_hours)
non-recurring engineering/development/flight test taken from Eastlake (no bottom-up model)

calibration.note: Eastlake manufacturing covers the whole airframe (parts, assembly, systems installation) while the bottom-up covers the structural parts — a ratio > 1 is expected; a ratio << 1 means the FOPV parameters (transport-wing parts) overestimate these parts: set labour_calibration from shop data (or 'eastlake')

L0.method: top-down CERs (modified Eastlake central; DAPCA IV as second CER)
L0.band_rule: wide end if outside the CER database, narrow end inside; half-way after a cost_L0 calibration

L1.band_rule: wide end with uncalibrated public process parameters or Eastlake anchoring (inherits L0 confidence); middle with a shop labour factor; narrow end after cost_L1 (L2) calibration

fidelity.recommended_why: conventional design inside the CER database and L1 not calibrated by shop/L2 data (public FOPV parameters): keep the CER as the reference, use L1 for relative choices
fidelity.note: use the recommended level; lower levels are kept for traceability and calibrated by the higher one (cost_calibration)

k_cost_L0_eastlake.what: unit cost L1 bottom-up / eastlake CER (same design, N, USD year)

k_cost_L0_dapca4.what: unit cost L1 bottom-up / dapca4 CER (same design, N, USD year)
